title: Three-Level Stack: Measurement → Snapshot → Motion
claim: Level 0 (Measurement): Λ_i = A_i · log₂(1 + T_i/D_i), units bits·s⁻¹. The Shannon layer IS the unit system. Level 0→1 Boundary: X_i = Λ_i/Λ_{i,ref}, dimensionless, X_i ∈ [0,1]. Each register is a fraction of its own full capacity. Level 1 (Snapshot): χ = C_W[∏ X_i], dimensionless. Level 2 (Motion): Ẋ = W·∇χ + η. RETIRED: 'All nine factors carry bits/s' — bits/s lives only in Level 0. RETIRED: 'Level 2 is Level 1 differentiated.'
assumptions: Shannon channel capacity as the measurement foundation
The reference capacity Λ_{i,ref} is itself a capacity, so the ratio is dimensionless
definitions: Level 1: dimensionless snapshot, fractions of full capacity
Level 2: open gradient dynamics, postulated not derived
negative_guards: Nine quantities in bits/s multiplied together give bits⁹·s⁻⁹, which means nothing. Each register enters as a fraction.
RETIRED: 'All nine factors carry bits/s.' Bits/s lives only in Level 0.
RETIRED: 'Level 2 is Level 1 differentiated.' Level 2 postulates first-order open gradient dynamics.
kill_conditions: Show that the Shannon layer does not function as a unit system for the ten laws.
Show that the dimensionless ratio X_i loses information critical to the law's operation.
